node.title: Re: Modules return value
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I have not found an explanation as to why Perl was created like this. Surely there must be a reason for it...

I think this is due to the relationship between [doc://use] being like a [doc://require] in a BEGIN, which in turn is like a [doc://do|do FILE], which in turn is like an [doc://eval]. [doc://eval] returns [doc://undef] when its code fails, and [doc://do] also has slightly more complex error cases:

unless ($return = do $file) { warn "couldn't parse $file: $@" if $@; warn "couldn't do $file: $!" unless defined $return; warn "couldn't run $file" unless $return; }

As a side note: [mod://Acme::ReturnValue]
